notes:
Kenan-Flagler (live): the "Recent Placements" section lists only placing institutions by area with no graduate names or years, so no records were written from it; only the 5 named job-market candidates (no year) were recorded. UNC STOR (live): "Ph.D. Alumni" list with Division (Statistics / Operations Research / INSTORE) and Year filters. The text copy contains only 30 alphabetical entries (Adams through Borysov), apparently the first page of a longer list, so the page is incomplete for census purposes. A single "

1962

" heading precedes the whole list in the HTML; it is not a per-person year (the same block includes recent graduates with 2010s-2020s advisors and postdoc placements), so listedYear is null for all 30 and yearMeaning is "unstated". Division (Statistics vs Operations Research) is not shown per person; program recorded as the department name. Placement strings sometimes include dates such as "(2000-)" and are kept verbatim in note. Wharton HCMG dissertations (live, https://hcmg.wharton.upenn.edu/programs/phd/dissertations/): the page lists dissertation titles under period headings ("On-going", "2011-2014", "2007-2010", ... "1987 - 1991") with no author names anywhere in the text or HTML, so no records could be written; it is readable, not a login wall. The titles could be matched to authors later via ProQuest/ScholarlyCommons, but that is outside this extraction. Siegen research-alumni profile (live): single-person profile page; one row written with the chunk's institution string, but the page itself never mentions the University of Sfax or a PhD year, so the institution attribution comes only from the chunk metadata. UW Foster (live): "Job Placements" page listing "recent job placements of doctoral students" by department and year heading (2016-2026), so yearMeaning is "placement" (it may coincide with the graduation year but the page does not say so). The 2026 heading lists placements of the current cycle. Entries written as "Title, Employer" were split into position/destination; entries giving only an institution (mostly 2016-2019) have position null. Entries written "Industry, Employer" have the employer in destination; two Marketing entries say only "Industry"; two entries say "No placement data". Management and Organization names carry track tags (SM/OB/TE) that were moved from the name into note. Degree is not stated per person; "PhD" is taken from the page title ("doctoral students"). One Marketing 2016 entry gives only a surname ("Dagogo-Jack").
